reviews.text: Fantastic experience at this new clinic! The team is very welcoming, kind, and professional. They took excellent care of my cat Rafiki, and I immediately felt confident in their presence!
While in Lyon with my dog ​​sick, I was able to easily get an appointment for my Spitz. Thank you again!
Excellent service and thank you again for taking such good care of my little cat Loulou. I will gladly recommend your practice.
Thank you so much for my little Billy and especially for your hospitality.

I received a truly warm welcome at this new practice.

Thank you so much for your kindness, patience, and expertise.
I leave feeling reassured about my little four-legged friend.

Plus, the practice is beautiful!
Fantastic new veterinary clinic. You immediately feel at ease as soon as you walk in. The vet is incredibly friendly and competent. She took excellent care of my little puppy. I highly recommend it.

You won't find anyone kinder or gentler than these two vets! On top of that, they're incredibly welcoming.
They take the time to explain everything thoroughly!
Honestly, go to them without hesitation; you won't be disappointed.

I recently discovered this newly opened veterinary clinic, and what a wonderful find! The premises are beautiful, reflecting the warm and caring welcome from the two veterinarians.

I came for my dog, who is usually extremely stressed at the vet. The vet examined him with great calm, gentleness, and patience. She was also finally able to make a diagnosis that no one had been able to identify until now. A real relief!

She is now the vet for both my dogs, and I couldn't be happier with this discovery.

I highly recommend this clinic to all pet owners! 🐾

After calling to schedule an appointment, I went to this clinic for my dog ​​who injured himself during a walk last night. Despite his initial reluctance, he was put at ease thanks to the gentleness and kindness of the veterinarians.
I received excellent advice and left feeling lighthearted with a happy dog ​​who enjoyed some treats after the consultation.
I highly recommend them!
